items.title: AI Scientists for Building Virtual-Cell Models
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Autonomous agents, from virtual laboratories to biological data-analysis agents and co-scientists, have begun to turn scientific goals into hypotheses. Whether they can go further and convert real, noisy and complex biological data into executable model hypotheses and architectures that encode testable assumptions remains unclear. Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations (i.e., modeling virtual cells) is a natural test of this ability: it is central to decoding disease mechanisms and therapeutic discovery, yet it demands cross-disciplinary expertise rarely concentrated in a single research group. Here, we introduce CellForge, an organized team of autonomous agents for single-cell perturbation modeling. Given a dataset and a task, it surveys the literature, parses the data, identifies relevant baselines, and formulates a model hypothesis through critic-mediated discussion among agents specialized in data modeling, single-cell biology, and deep learning. It then writes the training code, runs the experiments, and returns a trained predictor including architecture, code, and validation results. The architecture itself is the hypothesis: CellForge produces it end-to-end, with no human specifying the design, loss, or training protocol. Across six perturbation datasets spanning transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic contexts, CellForge yields models that are competitive with hand-crafted state-of-the-art results on established tasks and extends the same workflow to paired multiomic readouts. Blinded human evaluators rate CellForge’s research plans as more scientifically sound and innovative than those from single LLMs or deep-research systems. In summary, we show autonomous agents can complete the full hypothesis-to-validation cycle in single-cell biology, with an AI effectively building another AI, in a complex setting that currently requires a team of human experts.
items.summary_zh: CellForge 以多智能体协作完成单细胞扰动模型的假设、训练与验证流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖 6 个扰动数据集及配对多组学读出，并提供代码和验证结果；但仍是预印本，竞争性表现不等同于普适优势。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 自主智能体，从虚拟实验室到生物数据分析智能体和协作科学家，已开始将科学目标转化为假设。它们能否更进一步，把真实、嘈杂且复杂的生物数据转化为编码可检验假设的可执行模型假设与架构，仍不明确。预测细胞如何响应遗传和化学扰动（即构建虚拟细胞模型）是检验这种能力的自然任务：它对于解析疾病机制和治疗发现至关重要，却需要罕有地集中于单一研究组的跨学科专业知识。本文提出 CellForge：一个用于单细胞扰动建模的有组织自主智能体团队。给定数据集和任务后，它检索文献、解析数据、识别相关基线，并通过数据建模、单细胞生物学和深度学习专长智能体之间由批评者介导的讨论形成模型假设。随后，它编写训练代码、运行实验，并返回包含架构、代码和验证结果的已训练预测器。架构本身就是假设：CellForge 端到端地产生架构，无需人类指定设计、损失函数或训练方案。在涵盖转录组、表观基因组和蛋白质组背景的 6 个扰动数据集上，CellForge 产生的模型在既定任务中可与人工设计的最新结果竞争，并将相同工作流扩展至配对多组学读出。盲法人类评估者认为，CellForge 的研究计划比单个 LLM 或深度研究系统的计划在科学合理性和创新性上更强。总之，我们表明，自主智能体能够在单细胞生物学中完成从完整假设到验证的循环；AI 实际上在构建另一个 AI，而这一复杂任务目前需要一个人类专家团队。
items.author_line: Gerstein M, Tang X, Chen J, Shao Y, Yu Z, Cui Y, Wang W, Wu F, Liao Y, Zhuang Y, Shi W, Huang Z, Cohan A, Lin X, Krishnaswamy S, Theis F

items.title: Extracting Symptoms of Psychotic Disorders from Clinical Notes using Natural Language Processing.
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as tools for high-throughput, deep phenotyping of psychiatric disorders. Applied to electronic health records, LLMs could in principle extract patient symptoms, outcome trajectories, risk factors, and treatment history at scale and these, when combined with increasingly available biological data, such as genomics or neuroimaging, could provide powerful resources for health research. Although proof-of-principle LLM-based symptom extractions have been carried out for some medical conditions, the heterogeneous nature of psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia, requires extensive domain-specific evaluations. Here, we evaluate 14 general-purpose LLMs for extracting eight symptoms of schizophrenia from clinical summaries in a severe mental illness cohort (N = 704). Performance across symptoms was poor to moderate (macro F1 = 0.500 - 0.647), with positive symptoms more accurately extracted than negative symptoms. Few-shot prompting, a common strategy for improving LLM task performance, did not significantly improve these results. Nevertheless, LLM-predicted and gold-standard positive symptoms demonstrated comparable associations with clinical variables in regression analyses. Individual-level extraction errors attenuated group-level associations but did so unevenly across symptom domains. This indicates that general-purpose LLMs may not be able to extract psychosis-related phenotypes from clinical summaries with the quality required for clinical use but might nevertheless be useful for exploratory research on large cohorts. However, closing the performance gap between positive and negative symptom extractions seems essential groundwork to prevent a systematic bias in any LLM-derived characterisations of psychotic symptoms.
items.summary_zh: 在 N = 704 的重性精神疾病队列中，14 个通用 LLM 对精神分裂症症状抽取的表现为较差至中等。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这项临床文本评估量化了症状域偏倚，并明确提示通用 LLM 尚不具备临床使用所需质量。
items.abstract_zh: Large Language Models (LLMs) 被提议作为精神疾病高通量深度表型分析的工具。应用于电子健康记录时，LLMs 原则上可大规模提取患者症状、结局轨迹、风险因素和治疗史；这些信息与日益可获得的生物数据（如基因组学或神经影像学）结合后，可为健康研究提供强大资源。尽管已对某些疾病进行了基于 LLM 的症状抽取概念验证，精神疾病（包括精神分裂症）的异质性要求广泛的领域特异性评估。本文评估 14 个通用 LLM 从重性精神疾病队列的临床摘要中抽取精神分裂症 8 种症状的能力 (N = 704)。各症状的表现为较差至中等（macro F1 = 0.500 - 0.647），阳性症状的抽取准确性高于阴性症状。少样本提示这一常用于改善 LLM 任务性能的策略，并未显著改善这些结果。尽管如此，LLM 预测的阳性症状和金标准阳性症状在回归分析中显示出与临床变量相当的关联。个体层面的抽取错误削弱了组水平关联，但其削弱程度在不同症状域间并不均一。这表明，通用 LLM 可能无法以临床使用所需的质量从临床摘要中抽取精神病相关表型，但仍可能对大队列探索性研究有用。然而，缩小阳性和阴性症状抽取之间的性能差距，似乎是防止任何 LLM 衍生精神病症状表征出现系统性偏倚的必要基础工作。
items.author_line: Lock, S. K., Boisson, J., Evans, L. M., Shi, Y., Kappel, D. B., Walters, J. T. R., O'Donovan, M. C., Legge, S. E., Camacho-Collados, J., Pardinas, A. F.

items.title: 3D Spatial Interactomics Maps the Dynamics of NF-κB Multiprotein Signalosomes in Single Cells
items.abstract_or_text: NF{kappa}B signaling drives inflammatory responses by rapidly assembling membrane-proximal multiprotein supercomplexes, yet how these assemblies are organized in space and time within the 3D interior of a single cell has remained uncharacterized. We addressed this by profiling endogenous NF{kappa}B protein-protein interactions with an intelligent sequential proximity ligation assay (iseqPLA), read out by spinning disk confocal microscopy and 3D reconstruction. Each detected protein-protein proximity event is represented by a rolling-circle amplification product, and we treat clusters of co-localized puncta as a measure of supercomplex spatial organization. Across NIH-3T3 mouse fibroblasts, cystic fibrosis (CF) patient-derived macrophage co-cultures with IMR-90 human fibroblasts, and an independent set of healthy- and CF-donor monocyte-fibroblast co-cultures profiled by 3D iseqPLA, we tracked supercomplex dissociation, p65 nuclear translocation, and negative-feedback engagement across cytokine time courses. Three findings emerge: 3D volumetric quantification reduces the variance in nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio measurements relative to 2D projections, the choice of extracellular matrix coating shapes the fraction of NF{kappa}B-responsive cells, and CF airway-conditioned macrophages amplify paracrine NF{kappa}B signaling in neighboring fibroblasts in a CF model. A single-cell Generative Pretrained Transformer (scGPT) foundation model, fine-tuned on curated transcriptomic datasets, further places our NF{kappa}B gene panel within an inflammation-relevant feature space. Together, these results establish a 3D spatial interactomics workflow for dissecting supercomplex dynamics in health and disease.
items.summary_zh: 3D iseqPLA 在单细胞中追踪 NF{kappa}B 多蛋白信号复合体的空间与时间动态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究结合患者来源共培养、独立供体样本、3D 定量和 scGPT 特征定位，提供炎症细胞互作的实验工作流；CF 模型中的发现仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: NF{kappa}B 信号传导通过快速组装近膜多蛋白超级复合体来驱动炎症反应，然而这些组装体在单个细胞 3D 内部如何在空间和时间上组织，仍未得到表征。我们利用智能顺序近邻连接分析 (iseqPLA) 描绘内源性 NF{kappa}B 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，并以旋转盘共聚焦显微镜和 3D 重建读出。每个检测到的蛋白质-蛋白质近邻事件均由一个滚环扩增产物表示，我们将共定位斑点簇视为超级复合体空间组织的度量。我们在 NIH-3T3 小鼠成纤维细胞、囊性纤维化 (CF) 患者来源巨噬细胞与 IMR-90 人成纤维细胞的共培养体系，以及一组独立的健康供体和 CF 供体单核细胞-成纤维细胞共培养体系中，采用 3D iseqPLA 分析，在细胞因子时间进程中追踪超级复合体解离、p65 核转位和负反馈启动。出现三项发现：与 2D 投影相比，3D 体积定量降低了核质比测量的方差；细胞外基质包被的选择塑造了 NF{kappa}B 响应细胞的比例；并且在 CF 模型中，CF 气道条件化巨噬细胞增强了邻近成纤维细胞中的旁分泌 NF{kappa}B 信号。一个在整理过的转录组数据集上微调的单细胞 Generative Pretrained Transformer (scGPT) 基础模型，进一步将我们的 NF{kappa}B 基因面板置于炎症相关的特征空间中。总之，这些结果建立了一个用于剖析健康和疾病中超级复合体动态的 3D 空间互作组学工作流。
items.author_line: Zhang, N., Leese-Thompson, C., Ozuna, H., Peng, B., Sirigireddy, S., Nambiar, D., Ramanan, L., Tirouvanziam, R., Kopp, B., Coskun, A. F.

items.title: Setting the SCENE for Interpretable Cell-Gene Embeddings in Single-Cell RNA-seq
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell RNA sequencing measures cellular states at high resolution, but sparse high-dimensional count data remain difficult to model interpretably. We introduce the Single-Cell Euclidean Network Embedding (SCENE), a probabilistic latent-distance model that jointly embeds cells and genes from Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) counts. SCENE treats the count matrix as a weighted bipartite cell-gene graph, where Euclidean distances represent transcriptional affinity, and combines this geometry with a zero-inflated count likelihood that separates gene detection from expression magnitude. Across real and simulated scRNA-seq datasets, SCENE recovers biologically structured cell and gene embeddings with state-of-the-art performance. Surprisingly, major biological structure is preserved in native two- and three-dimensional latent spaces, enabling directly interpretable visualization. Perturbation analyses show that SCENE organizes glucocorticoid-response genes and T-cell receptor regulatory programs coherently in gene space, capturing biology beyond cell-type separation. SCENE provides a transparent representation learning framework in which low-dimensional Euclidean geometry supports accurate modeling and biological interpretation.
items.summary_zh: SCENE 以可解释的低维欧氏几何联合嵌入单细胞和基因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在真实和模拟 scRNA-seq 数据中报告具竞争力的表现，并通过扰动分析支持其生物学解释性。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序以高分辨率测量细胞状态，但稀疏的高维计数数据仍难以被可解释地建模。我们提出 Single-Cell Euclidean Network Embedding (SCENE)，这是一种从 Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) 计数中联合嵌入细胞和基因的概率潜在距离模型。SCENE 将计数矩阵视为加权的二部细胞-基因图，其中欧氏距离代表转录亲和性，并将这一几何结构与零膨胀计数似然相结合，以区分基因检出与表达量大小。在真实和模拟 scRNA-seq 数据集上，SCENE 恢复了具有生物学结构的细胞和基因嵌入，并达到最新水平的性能。令人意外的是，主要生物学结构在原生二维和三维潜在空间中得以保留，从而可直接进行可解释的可视化。扰动分析表明，SCENE 在基因空间中连贯地组织糖皮质激素反应基因和 T 细胞受体调控程序，捕获了超越细胞类型分离的生物学信息。SCENE 提供了一个透明的表征学习框架，其中低维欧氏几何支持准确建模和生物学解释。
items.author_line: Moberg, O. L., Petersen, M. B., Herlau, T., Kristensen, L. E., Jessen, L. E., Morup, M.

items.title: OpenAntigens: a structure-aware database for antigen construct design across the human cell-surface and secreted proteome
items.abstract_or_text: Choosing which region of a protein to express remains poorly standardized in antibody discovery, recombinant reagent generation, structural biology and computational binder design. For human cell-surface and secreted proteins, this requires reconciling topology, processing, predicted and experimental structure, modifications, interaction partners, orthologs, paralogs and cross-reactivity risk before ordering DNA. OpenAntigens is a free, no-login database of construct-design reports for 5328 human secreted, GPI-anchored, single-pass and multipass proteins. It integrates UniProt topology, AlphaFold pLDDT and PAE, PDB precedent, InterPro and Pfam domains, mouse and cynomolgus orthologs, paralog and family context, Open Targets disease associations, partner and assembly context, and BLAST searches. It provides 55 305 construct suggestions spanning full design regions, PDB-backed boundaries, annotated domains, pLDDT/PAE-derived regions and membrane-expression options, plus 148 722 sequence-similarity hits to help choose constructs and assess cross-reactivity. For targets with compatible AlphaFold models, the interactive designer links sequence, structure, pLDDT and PAE, allowing users to revise boundaries and export species-equivalent sequences with real-time cysteine and modification warnings. OpenAntigens places reproducible construct suggestions, comparative context and browser editing in one workflow, reducing manual reconciliation across resources. OpenAntigens is available at openantigens.org.
items.summary_zh: OpenAntigens 为 5,328 个人类细胞表面和分泌蛋白提供结构感知的抗原构建体设计报告。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开放资源整合结构、拓扑、同源性和交叉反应风险信息，并给出 55,305 个构建建议，服务抗体、结构生物学和计算结合剂设计。
items.abstract_zh: 在抗体发现、重组试剂制备、结构生物学和计算结合剂设计中，选择蛋白质的哪个区域进行表达仍缺乏标准化。对于人类细胞表面和分泌蛋白，在订购 DNA 之前，需要协调拓扑、加工、预测和实验结构、修饰、相互作用伙伴、直系同源物、旁系同源物以及交叉反应风险。OpenAntigens 是一个免费、无需登录的数据库，为 5,328 个人类分泌蛋白、GPI 锚定蛋白、单跨膜蛋白和多跨膜蛋白提供构建体设计报告。它整合 UniProt 拓扑、AlphaFold pLDDT 和 PAE、PDB 先例、InterPro 和 Pfam 结构域、小鼠和食蟹猴直系同源物、旁系同源物与家族背景、Open Targets 疾病关联、伙伴与组装背景，以及 BLAST 搜索。它提供 55,305 条构建体建议，涵盖完整设计区域、PDB 支持的边界、注释结构域、pLDDT/PAE 衍生区域和膜表达选项，并提供 148,722 个序列相似性命中，以帮助选择构建体并评估交叉反应性。对于具有兼容 AlphaFold 模型的靶点，交互式设计器连接序列、结构、pLDDT 和 PAE，使用户能够修订边界，并在实时半胱氨酸和修饰警告下导出物种等效序列。OpenAntigens 将可复现的构建体建议、比较背景和浏览器编辑置于一个工作流中，减少了跨资源的人工协调。OpenAntigens 可在 openantigens.org 获取。
items.author_line: Teixeira, A. A. R., Zhu, H., Kothiwal, D., Cao, R., Mills, A.

items.title: Large Language Model-derived Symptom Clusters and Patient Outcomes in Colorectal Cancer from MIMIC-IV Clinical Notes
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Prior research on symptom clusters (SCs) in colorectal cancer (CRC) has relied primarily on patient-reported outcome surveys, which capture symptom experience at discrete assessment points rather than the continuous documentation generated during routine care, leaving open whether SCs derived from electronic health record (EHR) text carry the same clinical meaning and predictive value. To construct and validate patient-level symptom co-occurrence networks from large language model (LLM), extracted symptom data in CRC patients, and to test whether resulting SCs predict clinical outcomes. Methods: Using a zero-shot LLM extraction pipeline previously benchmarked against a manually annotated ground truth (Macro F1=0.70 for the best-performing model), we extracted 46 symptoms from 2,728 discharge notes of 1,507 CRC patients in MIMIC-IV. Patient-level symptom co-occurrence networks were constructed independently from Gemini 3.5 Flash and Claude Haiku extractions using phi correlation and Louvain community detection, with sensitivity analyses across correlation thresholds, random seeds, note-aggregation strategy, and bootstrap resampling. Per-cluster symptom burden scores were tested as predictors of in-hospital mortality, 30-day readmission, and 1-year mortality using logistic regression adjusted for age, sex, and (in sensitivity models) metastatic disease. Results: Both LLMs' networks converged on three clinically coherent SCs (Systemic, Gastrointestinal, and CRC Disease-Specific) across sensitivity analyses (cross-model Adjusted Rand Index=0.727; 100-seed Louvain ARI=0.985; bootstrap ARI=0.733). The Systemic Symptom Cluster was the most consistent predictor of in-hospital mortality (OR=1.33) and 1-year mortality (OR=1.41), while the CRC Disease-Specific Cluster specifically and independently predicted 30-day readmission (OR=1.20); both associations were robust to adjustment for metastatic disease. Conclusion: LLM-extracted symptom data recover clinically coherent, reproducible SCs from unstructured discharge notes that carry independent prognostic value for mortality and readmission, supporting the clinical validity of automated, EHR-derived symptom profiling in CRC.
items.summary_zh: LLM 从 MIMIC-IV 临床文本提取的结直肠癌症状簇，与死亡和再入院结局呈经调整后的关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 两种模型和多重敏感性分析支持症状簇的稳定性，但研究是观察性关联，不能将症状簇解释为导致结局的原因。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：既往关于结直肠癌 (CRC) 症状簇 (SCs) 的研究主要依赖患者报告结局调查；这类调查在离散评估时间点捕捉症状体验，而不能覆盖常规护理中持续产生的记录，因此尚不清楚从电子健康记录 (EHR) 文本导出的 SCs 是否具有相同的临床含义和预测价值。本研究旨在从 CRC 患者中由 Large Language Model (LLM) 提取的症状数据构建并验证患者层面的症状共现网络，并检验所得 SCs 是否预测临床结局。方法：使用先前已针对人工标注金标准进行基准测试的零样本 LLM 抽取流程（最佳模型 Macro F1=0.70），我们从 MIMIC-IV 中 1,507 名 CRC 患者的 2,728 份出院记录中抽取了 46 种症状。采用 phi 相关和 Louvain 社区检测，分别基于 Gemini 3.5 Flash 和 Claude Haiku 的抽取结果构建患者层面的症状共现网络，并在相关阈值、随机种子、记录聚合策略和 bootstrap 重采样方面进行敏感性分析。使用经年龄、性别以及（在敏感性模型中）转移性疾病校正的 logistic regression，检验每个簇的症状负担评分对院内死亡、30 天再入院和 1 年死亡的预测作用。结果：两种 LLM 的网络均在敏感性分析中收敛为 3 个临床连贯的 SCs（Systemic、Gastrointestinal 和 CRC Disease-Specific）（跨模型 Adjusted Rand Index=0.727；100-seed Louvain ARI=0.985；bootstrap ARI=0.733）。Systemic Symptom Cluster 是院内死亡 (OR=1.33) 和 1 年死亡 (OR=1.41) 最一致的预测因子，而 CRC Disease-Specific Cluster 特异且独立地预测 30 天再入院 (OR=1.20)；两种关联在针对转移性疾病校正后均保持稳健。结论：LLM 提取的症状数据可从非结构化出院记录中恢复具有临床连贯性、可复现的 SCs，这些 SCs 对死亡和再入院具有独立的预后价值，支持 CRC 中自动化、EHR 衍生症状画像的临床有效性。
items.author_line: Lee, Y., Dinov, I., Hu, X., Jiang, Y.

items.title: Clinical trial success prediction from open registry text using classical machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Drug candidates that fail in clinical trials may expose participants to unsafe or ineffective interventions and divert limited development capacity from more promising programs. This study assessed whether public registry text could be used to estimate clinical trial outcomes. The Clinical Trial Outcome Dataset (CTOD), developed by Gao and colleagues, provides open labels for about 125,000 clinical trials. Logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting models were built to use only ClinicalTrials.gov text, with temporal hold-out and evaluation across Phases 1, 2, and 3. To reduce leakage, fields directly related to outcome were removed, and 187 pre-2019 trials containing post-outcome text were excluded before the 27 models were refit. Random forest had the highest mean ROC-AUC (0.668) and mean Brier skill (0.069), while the strongest configuration reached ROC-AUC 0.738 in Phase 1. Against 7,260 manually adjudicated hard-case trials, phase-specific random-forest ROC-AUCs were 0.668 to 0.686. All-indication training improved ROC-AUC for neuroscience in all nine paired comparisons. Deduplication, removal of organizational fields, and targeted cleanup of residual outcome-related language did not materially change the results. Together, these findings support the use of open registry text in a low-compute workflow for benchmarking trial outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 仅用公开注册文本训练的传统机器学习模型，在约 125,000 项临床试验上预测试验结局。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究使用时间留出、人工判定的难例和针对结果泄漏的清理；预测性能中等，适合作为开放基准而非试验决策替代。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 临床试验失败的候选药物可能使参与者暴露于不安全或无效的干预，并将有限的开发能力从更有前景的项目中分流。本研究评估公开注册文本是否可用于估计临床试验结局。Gao 及其同事开发的 Clinical Trial Outcome Dataset (CTOD) 为约 125,000 项临床试验提供开放标签。构建 logistic regression、random forest 和 gradient boosting 模型，仅使用 ClinicalTrials.gov 文本，并采用时间留出，在 Phase 1、2 和 3 中进行评估。为减少泄漏，移除了与结局直接相关的字段，并在重新拟合 27 个模型前，排除了 187 项含有结局后文本的 2019 年前试验。Random forest 具有最高的平均 ROC-AUC (0.668) 和平均 Brier skill (0.069)，而最强配置在 Phase 1 达到 ROC-AUC 0.738。针对 7,260 项经人工判定的难例试验，分期 random-forest ROC-AUC 为 0.668 至 0.686。在全部适应症训练中，神经科学在全部 9 个配对比较中的 ROC-AUC 均得到提高。去重、移除机构字段和针对残余结局相关语言的定向清理，并未实质改变结果。总之，这些发现支持在低计算量工作流中使用开放注册文本对试验结局进行基准测试。

items.title: Sparse Machine Learning Pipeline with Stabl Identifies Cord Blood Multi-Omic Signatures of Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Several omics studies have been completed in recent years, with the goal of identifying biomarkers of complex multifactorial diseases, such as bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD). Objective: To evaluate the performance of 3 distinct omics platforms, using a machine learning pipeline with integration of sparse, reliable and adaptive biomarker identification (Stabl). Methods: Using a well-characterized birth cohort, cord blood metabolomics, proteomics and adductomics data were integrated with Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression and Stabl, to evaluate predictive performance for BPD. Results: Sparse multivariable modeling of 45,000 features measured in 217 infants (52 term, 165 extremely preterm <28 weeks; 82 with BPD and 35 with severe BPD/death) identified a perfect signature for preterm birth with both LASSO and Stabl (AUROC=1.0; p<0.001). Analysis of the preterm group yielded excellent predictive power for severe BPD (AUROC=0.83; p=0.005). Stabl identified a set of 12 biomarkers (2 adducts, 3 proteins and 7 metabolites) with good performance for predicting grade III BPD (AUROC=0.76; P=0.03). Biomarkers across the 3 omics platforms revealed dysregulated pathways of innate/adaptive immune responses, metabolic programming and oxidative stress. Conclusions: The sparse machine learning pipeline is a complementary approach for identifying novel pathways and biomarkers of multifactorial BPD and its endotypes.
items.summary_zh: Stabl 稀疏学习整合脐带血代谢组、蛋白质组和加合物组，识别支气管肺发育不良特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 217 名婴儿和 45,000 个特征上进行多组学建模，并报告严重 BPD 的预测结果；队列规模有限，需外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：近年来已完成多项组学研究，目标是识别复杂多因素疾病（如支气管肺发育不良 (BPD)）的生物标志物。目的：使用整合稀疏、可靠和自适应生物标志物识别 (Stabl) 的机器学习流程，评估 3 个不同组学平台的表现。方法：利用一个表征充分的出生队列，将脐带血代谢组、蛋白质组和加合物组数据与 Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression 及 Stabl 整合，以评估 BPD 的预测性能。结果：对 217 名婴儿中测得的 45,000 个特征进行稀疏多变量建模（52 名足月儿、165 名胎龄 <28 周的极早产儿；82 例 BPD，35 例重度 BPD/死亡），以 LASSO 和 Stabl 均识别出早产的完美特征组合 (AUROC=1.0；p<0.001)。对早产组的分析显示，对重度 BPD 具有优异预测能力 (AUROC=0.83；p=0.005)。Stabl 识别出一组 12 个生物标志物（2 个加合物、3 个蛋白质和 7 个代谢物），对预测 III 级 BPD 有良好表现 (AUROC=0.76；P=0.03)。3 个组学平台中的生物标志物揭示了先天/适应性免疫反应、代谢编程和氧化应激的失调通路。结论：该稀疏机器学习流程是识别 BPD 及其内型的新通路和生物标志物的补充方法。
items.author_line: Mestan, K., Newar, J., Zhao, J., Chakraborty, A., Reiss, J., Funk, W., Stelzer, I., Waked, B., Bellan, G., Durand, X., Hedou, J.

items.title: The Judge is Not Impartial: Self-Preference in Medical LLM Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate model-generated medical content, creating a potential circularity: an LLM judge may favor outputs generated by the same model independently of clinical quality. To characterize LLM judge self-preference in medical settings, we measured same-model affinity in single-turn specialist question answering and multi-turn standardized-patient encounters. We evaluated eight models, two from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Qwen, on 620 real point of care questions from clinicians (Real-POCQi). The same eight models also generated and judged 200 standardized patient-clinician scenarios (MedSP1000) up to 8 visible turns. In total, our analysis spans 13,760 LLM judgments. We define three complementary measures of self-preference. Answer Rank Bias, our primary measure, compared the rank assigned to a fixed response by its own-model judge with its average rank from outside judges. Answer Score Bias made the analogous comparison using rubric scores. Own-Answer Win Rate measured how often a judge ranked its own model’s response above a competitor. Higher values across all these measures indicate greater degrees of self-preference. In Real-POCQi, pooled Answer Rank Bias was +1.22 positions, and all eight judges favored their own answers. Self-preference persisted both with and without a grading rubric. Revealing generator identities modestly weakened self-preference by an average of −0.094 positions. In MedSP1000, pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from +0.53 to +0.62 positions, with no clear difference by conversation length (p = 0.17). LLM judges systematically favored responses generated by their own models across multiple formats. Clinical AI deployments should exercise increased vigilance including multiple evaluation measures and judge panels spanning differing model families when deploying LLM-as-a-judge systems.
items.summary_zh: 医学 LLM 作为裁判时，8 个模型均表现出偏向自身生成答案的系统性偏好。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究覆盖 620 个真实临床问题、200 个标准化患者情景和 13,760 次判断，为医疗 LLM 评测提出跨模型裁判组的具体依据。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 Large language models (LLMs) 日益被用于评估模型生成的医学内容，这带来潜在的循环性：LLM 裁判可能独立于临床质量而偏爱由同一模型生成的输出。为刻画医学场景中 LLM 裁判的自我偏好，我们在单轮专科问答和多轮标准化患者就诊中测量了同模型亲和性。我们在来自临床医生的 620 个真实即时照护问题 (Real-POCQi) 上评估了 8 个模型，其中各有 2 个来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 和 Qwen。同样的 8 个模型还生成并裁判了 200 个标准化患者-临床医生情景 (MedSP1000)，每个情景最多 8 个可见轮次。总计，我们的分析涵盖 13,760 次 LLM 判断。我们定义了 3 个互补的自我偏好度量。作为主要度量的 Answer Rank Bias，将自身模型裁判给予固定回答的排名与外部裁判给予该回答的平均排名进行比较。Answer Score Bias 使用 rubric 分数进行类似比较。Own-Answer Win Rate 则衡量裁判将自己模型的回答排在竞争模型回答之前的频率。所有这些度量的较高值均表示更高程度的自我偏好。在 Real-POCQi 中，合并后的 Answer Rank Bias 为 +1.22 个名次，且全部 8 个裁判都偏爱自己的回答。无论是否提供评分 rubric，自我偏好均持续存在。披露生成者身份使自我偏好平均仅减弱 −0.094 个名次。在 MedSP1000 中，合并后的 Answer Rank Bias 为 +0.53 至 +0.62 个名次，且与对话长度没有明确差异 (p = 0.17)。LLM 裁判在多种形式中系统性偏爱由其自身模型生成的回答。部署临床 AI 时，应提高警惕，包括在部署 LLM-as-a-judge 系统时采用多种评估度量，并使用跨不同模型家族的裁判组。
items.author_line: Daneshjou R, Natarajan S, Ansari Z, Yip V, Lin C, Udash A, Garvey M, Fanous A

items.title: Machine learning reveals sequence and genomic context features underlying Alu-specific effects on genome folding
items.abstract_or_text: The Alu transposable element is among the most abundant classes of mobile DNA in the human genome, and has been linked to gene regulation and chromatin organization. Yet how individual Alu insertions influence nearby chromatin interactions remains poorly understood. To investigate this, we used deep learning to perform a genome-wide in silico deletion screen of ~1.1 million Alus, predicting each element's importance to local genome folding. We identified a subset of high-scoring Alus that span multiple Alu subfamilies and are enriched in loci that are fast-evolving and gene-dense, especially loci encoding genes that are actively transcribed and/or related to Alu biology. We further found that polymorphic Alus preferentially occur in regions tolerant of sequence variation but predicted to be resistant to changes in chromatin structure. Targeted in silico mutagenesis showed that the importance of individual Alus to local chromatin interactions depends on both intrinsic Alu sequence properties and genomic context. Finally, we identified Alu sequences predicted to alter CTCF-mediated boundary strength and, in some cases, to promote the formation of new loops and boundaries. Together, these results position Alus as key modulators of genome architecture, while underscoring that the fate of a new Alu depends on where it inserts and how it interacts with other determinants of chromatin state and structure.
items.summary_zh: 深度学习对约 110 万个 Alu 的全基因组 in silico 删除分析，定位可能影响局部染色质折叠的元件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把序列属性和基因组环境共同纳入大规模筛选；结论来自计算预测和 in silico 突变，仍有待实验检验。
items.abstract_zh: Alu 转座元件是人类基因组中最丰富的移动 DNA 类别之一，并与基因调控和染色质组织有关。然而，单个 Alu 插入如何影响附近染色质相互作用，仍知之甚少。为研究这一问题，我们使用深度学习对约 110 万个 Alu 进行全基因组 in silico 删除筛选，预测每个元件对局部基因组折叠的重要性。我们识别出一部分高分 Alu；它们跨越多个 Alu 亚家族，富集于快速进化且基因密集的位点，尤其是编码活跃转录和/或与 Alu 生物学相关基因的位点。我们还发现，多态性 Alu 优先出现于能够耐受序列变异、但被预测为抵抗染色质结构改变的区域。定向 in silico 突变显示，单个 Alu 对局部染色质相互作用的重要性取决于 Alu 内在序列性质和基因组环境。最后，我们识别出被预测可改变 CTCF 介导边界强度的 Alu 序列，并且在某些情况下可促进新环和新边界的形成。总之，这些结果将 Alu 定位为基因组架构的关键调节因子，同时强调新 Alu 的命运取决于其插入位置及其与染色质状态和结构其他决定因素的相互作用。

items.title: Discovery of microbial intergenic features with genomic language modeling and multimodal search
items.abstract_or_text: Systematic characterization of microbial noncoding regions is limited by two distinct challenges: discovery of conserved sequence features without predefined motifs and functional interpretation of newly identified elements. We address these challenges by training a sparse autoencoder on genomic language model (gLM2) representations to identify intergenic sequence features without prior annotation, and by implementing multimodal search to generate functional hypotheses from conserved associations with neighboring proteins, RNA families, and genomic organization. This framework uncovered divergent, previously uncharacterized noncoding elements, including candidate regulatory DNA sequences and structured RNAs not captured by existing annotation models. gLM2-derived intergenic features can be explored through SeqHub's multimodal search, freely available for academic use at seqhub.org.
items.summary_zh: gLM2 表征上的稀疏自编码器和多模态检索发现微生物非编码区候选功能元件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法不依赖预先定义的 motif，并将候选元件开放至 SeqHub 检索；功能仍为由保守关联生成的假设。
items.abstract_zh: 微生物非编码区的系统表征受到两项不同挑战的限制：在没有预定义 motif 的情况下发现保守序列特征，以及对新识别元件进行功能解释。我们通过在基因组语言模型 (gLM2) 表征上训练稀疏自编码器，在无需事先注释的情况下识别基因间序列特征，并实现多模态搜索，以从与相邻蛋白、RNA 家族和基因组组织的保守关联中生成函数假设，从而解决这些挑战。该框架发现了多样的、此前未表征的非编码元件，包括现有注释模型未捕获的候选调控 DNA 序列和结构化 RNA。可通过 SeqHub 的多模态搜索探索 gLM2 衍生的基因间特征；SeqHub 在 seqhub.org 面向学术用途免费开放。
items.author_line: Zulaybar, N., Tranzillo, M., Silverstein, R., Hwang, Y., Cornman, A.

items.title: MMAD-Risk: Multivariate Mixed Survival Analysis for the Prediction of Age-Dependent Disease Risks from Plasma Proteomes
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation: Multivariate survival analysis with hundreds of correlated outcomes is computationally challenging. Established approaches either ignore correlations between response variables, rely on black-box deep learning or are limited to small-scale outcomes. Results: We introduce MMAD-Risk, a novel multivariate mixed accelerated failure time (AFT) model that enables scalable analysis of high-dimensional survival analysis data. We train MMAD-Risk using amortized variational inference where we design the variational distribution such that it factorizes across diseases, allowing us to decompose multivariate disease risk prediction into a series of tractable, one-dimensional problems. This allows us to calculate the ELBO analytically, enabling fast computation. The model employs a low-rank decomposition of the effect size matrix B = VW to capture shared disease mechanisms and latent random effects Vz to model comorbidity. MMAD-Risk is trained on the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics cohort (N {approx} 55000, P {approx} 3000 proteins, D = 271 diseases). Using the full 3,000-protein dataset, MMAD-Risk achieved a mean concordance index (c-index) of 0.744 for diagnoses occurring [>=] 10 years after blood sample collection, outperforming a Cox proportional hazards model (mean c-index = 0.709). Greedy backward selection identified a 10-protein panel that preserved > 99% of the full-model performance. On this reduced panel MMAD-Risk still outperformed Cox regression (0.738 vs. 0.679).
items.summary_zh: MMAD-Risk 在 UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics 的约 55,000 人、约 3,000 种蛋白和 271 种疾病上进行多变量生存风险预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在远期诊断预测中优于 Cox 回归，并将模型压缩为保留超过 99% 性能的 10 蛋白面板；结果来自单一队列，外部泛化尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 动机：具有数百个相关结局的多变量生存分析在计算上具有挑战性。既有方法要么忽略反应变量之间的相关性，要么依赖黑箱深度学习，要么仅限于少量结局。结果：我们提出 MMAD-Risk，这是一种新型多变量混合 accelerated failure time (AFT) 模型，可对高维生存分析数据进行可扩展分析。我们使用 amortized variational inference 训练 MMAD-Risk；我们将变分分布设计为跨疾病分解，从而可将多变量疾病风险预测分解为一系列可处理的一维问题。这使我们能够解析地计算 ELBO，从而实现快速计算。该模型采用效应量矩阵 B = VW 的低秩分解来捕捉共享疾病机制，并采用潜在随机效应 Vz 来建模共病。MMAD-Risk 在 UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics 队列上训练 (N {approx} 55000，P {approx} 3000 proteins，D = 271 diseases)。使用完整的 3,000-protein 数据集时，对于采血后 [>=] 10 年发生的诊断，MMAD-Risk 的平均 concordance index (c-index) 达到 0.744，优于 Cox proportional hazards model（平均 c-index = 0.709）。贪婪后向选择识别出一个 10-protein panel，保留了完整模型 > 99% 的性能。在这一缩减面板上，MMAD-Risk 仍优于 Cox regression (0.738 vs. 0.679)。

review.note: 入选 16 项，均为 preprint；结论按摘要所述的计算、实验或观察性证据表述，未视为同行评审或临床验证结论。
